description: List all of this site's own published articles in one unpaged response. Output is { articles: [{ slug, title, summary, date, status, tags, url, md_url }] }. There is no limit or offset. Takes no parameters: call with an empty object. Use get_article instead when you have a slug and need the Markdown. Use search_sources instead for third-party papers, specs, and reports. Use list_changes instead for recent edits (article rows prefix the id with article:). A failed read returns isError. The text is the Error message (Fetch failed <status> <url> when the HTTP status is not OK), or Article list failed. when the failure is not an Error. Free, no auth.
name: list_articles
title: List published articles
